summary: Feshi territory in southern Kwango province (secteurs Feshi, Kisanji and Mwela Lembwa) lies far from the eastern DRC conflict zones and south of the main Mobondo militia theatre (Kwamouth, Bagata, Kenge/northern Kwango). No armed group is known to hold territory in Feshi. The territorial capital Feshi (listed as 'Kwilu') and rural villages are under ordinary state authority, with the PNC as the main permanent force alongside the territorial administration and customary chiefs. Web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, search/news sites blocked), so all zones rest on default state presence; rural villages, particularly in northern Mwela Lembwa toward Kenge territory, carry low confidence given Mobondo activity in the wider region.

zones.evidence: Seat of Feshi territory with territorial administration and PNC commissariat; no reported armed-group control. Web research unavailable for this run, so this rests on default state presence.
